Experience this incredible 265± acre ranch for sale in Milam County, Texas, offering the perfect combination of luxury living, recreational opportunities, and productive ranch land. This stunning Texas ranch features a custom-built 4,695± square foot home, a beautiful guest house, a resort-style infinity pool, Alligator Creek frontage, and abundant wildlife, making it an exceptional property for hunting, ranching, or a private country retreat.

Situated in the heart of Central Texas, this fully fenced ranch offers approximately 2,200 feet of Alligator Creek, a scenic 4± acre pond, two barns, two water wells, and a greenhouse. Whether you're searching for a Texas hunting ranch, luxury ranch for sale, recreational property, or country estate with acreage, this property is designed to impress.

Property Highlights

• 265± Acres in Milam County, Texas
• Custom-Built 4,695± Sq. Ft. Home
• 1,200± Sq. Ft. Guest House
• Resort-Style Infinity Pool with Waterfall & Slide
• Approximately 2,200± Feet of Alligator Creek
• 4± Acre Pond
• Two Barns
• Greenhouse
• Two Water Wells
• Fully Fenced Property
• Excellent Wildlife and Hunting Opportunities

If you're looking for a premier Texas ranch for sale with luxury amenities, outstanding water features, and exceptional recreational opportunities, this Milam County property deserves a closer look.
